title: Waterfall chart
summary: A waterfall chart: how a start value becomes an end value through positive and negative steps, a bar per step on a value axis from zero, a change floating from the running total and a total standing on zero, joined by thin lines, in the success, error and neutral tones with each value written with its sign, a closing total added, a key, a tooltip, a keyboard cursor over the steps, a summary in words, and the same data as a table.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

label.description: What the chart shows, in a few words: its accessible name and the table's caption. Required in practice: without it the chart is named «График».

x.description: The field of the steps' names, in the data's order; the first field other than the value and the total mark when unset.

y.description: The field of the values: a change (positive or negative) on a step, the total itself on a total row; the first numeric field other than x and the total mark when unset.

total.description: The field that marks a total row (true, 1, «yes» or «да»). A total row stands on zero: without a value it shows the running total, with one the running total starts again from it, as an opening balance does.

end.description: auto closes the steps with a total named «Итого» unless the last row is a total already; none draws the rows only.

value-labels.description: auto writes each bar's value on it, a change with its sign and a total as it is, when every one fits its band; none leaves them to the tooltip and the table.

legend.description: auto shows the key of rise, fall and total above the plot.

tooltip.description: step: under the pointer or the cursor, the step's name, its change and the total it reaches.

grid.description: value draws guide lines across the plot at the value ticks.

x-label.description: The name of the steps, said under the axis and as the table's first column; the x field's name when unset.

y-label.description: The name of the value, said above the axis.

y-format.description: The values' format: number, integer, decimal-<n>, compact, currency-<CODE> or unit-<unit>, in the page's language.

size.description: The rung of the size ladder: the plot's height, the text and the gaps. 1/2 for a card, 2 for a page of its own.

table.description: The same data as a table: toggle offers a button that swaps the plot for it, visible shows it under the plot, hidden keeps it for screen readers only. Never none: the table is the chart's text.

summary.description: auto: a sentence of what the data does (the count of changes, the start and the end with the change between them, the step that added most and the one that took away most, how many rose and fell), said before the plot. The description slot adds the host's own words.

data-state.description: auto: ready with steps, empty without. loading draws the frame without marks; error offers «Повторить», which sends refresh.

items.description: The data: a list of records, one per step ([{step, value, total}, …]), or an object of columns. A step is a change from the running total; a row marked as a total stands on zero. A change without a value is left out; the summary says how many.

colors.description: The colours of rise, fall and total: {up: 'success', down: 'error', total: 'neutral'} by default. A colour is a Framework role, which follows the theme, or any CSS colour or variable; anything else is dropped with a console report, as is a colour under 3:1 against the background (drawn all the same). Each bar's value keeps its sign whatever the colour.

sf-chart-waterfall-select.summary: The person chose a step: a click on its band, or Enter or Space on the keyboard cursor. index is its place among the bars, row its row in items (-1 for the closing total the chart adds), x its name, kind up, down or total, value the change (the total itself on a total), total the level it reaches.

sf-chart-waterfall-refresh.summary: The person asked for the data again from the error state; the host loads it and sets items.

accessibility.focus: One Tab stop on the plot, then the table button. The summary is the plot's description; each cursor move is said politely.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chart-waterfall to show how a start value becomes an end value through positive and negative steps: a profit bridge, a budget's changes, a headcount's moves.
do_not: Do not draw a chart without a label
Do not use it for independent values that do not add up; a sf-chart-bar reads them
Do not use it for a change over many periods; a sf-chart-line shows a trend
